face_design: data/face-design.json; sourced species shape interpreted by generator
final_face_hair_lines:
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): compact face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, large size, upturned outer corners, close-set; straight medium brows; straight slender bridge nose; thin lips.
HAIR: short feathered, side-swept bangs.
face_choice_reason: Pikipek uses compact soft jaw and close large upturned eyes with short feathered hair; Trumbeak uses wider structured jaw and narrower hooded eyes with longer angular feathered layers.
comparison_observation: Recent water characters have long soft blue hair or rounded blue bob; these anchors use dark sharply feathered layers, black-white division and red crest. Pikipek has rounder cheeks, larger gray eyes and a compact jaw, while Trumbeak has a longer chin and narrow red-brown eyes.
original_policy: Original PNG stays session-only; records keep sha256 and actual prompt/UI.
encoding_note: One unpublished WebP conversion became empty after initial validation. Re-encoded from the same original PNG atomically; all nine files opened and full pixel data revalidated immediately before publication.
